_notes: C1 /process/ (A12 #2). overview feeds the home 4-step timeline. Steps are taken from the service files' process lists; every deliverable is something the service copy already promises. The guarantee is built on [WARRANTY] and makes no promise beyond it. Owner to confirm each step before launch.

seo.title: How We Work: Steps and Guarantee | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: How RNC Landscaping goes from your request to finished work, what you receive at each step, and how our workmanship guarantee works. No prices online.

lede: What happens from your first request to finished work, and what you receive at each step.

overview.title: Request
overview.body: Tell us about the property and the work on our [free quote form](/free-quote/). Your email app opens with the request written out, and you can attach photos before you send it. We reply within [REPLY TIME].

overview.title: Site visit
overview.body: If the job needs one, we visit to measure, look at access and check the local rules that apply.

overview.title: Written quote
overview.body: You get a written scope and schedule before any work starts. The quote is free.

overview.title: Scheduled work
overview.body: Work goes ahead on the agreed dates, with one contact for questions and changes.

tracks.name: Maintenance track
tracks.summary: For recurring grounds care: mowing, bed care, pruning and seasonal cleanups for homes, stratas and commercial sites.

steps.title: Send a request
steps.body: Share the address, the type of property and what you need looked after.
steps.deliverable: A reply within [REPLY TIME] with any questions and a time for a site walk.

steps.title: Site walk
steps.body: We walk the site with you or whoever looks after it, noting the lawn, beds, hedges and how we get in.
steps.deliverable: Notes on the lawn areas, beds, hedges and access that the quote will cover.

steps.title: Written scope and schedule
steps.body: We turn the walk into a quote that you or your council can review.
steps.deliverable: A written quote listing the tasks for each visit, how often we come and the season it covers.

steps.title: Regular visits
steps.body: Visits follow the written scope, and one contact handles your questions and changes.
steps.deliverable: Visit notes on anything that needs attention, passed on before we act.

steps.title: Seasonal check-in
steps.body: Before each season we review what is working and what should change.
steps.deliverable: An updated plan for the season ahead.

tracks.name: Installation track
tracks.summary: For one-time projects: planting, sod, patios, paths, retaining walls, new irrigation and larger tree work.

steps.title: Tell us what you have in mind
steps.body: Describe the project and send photos or drawings if you have them.
steps.deliverable: A reply within [REPLY TIME] and a time for a site visit.

steps.title: Site visit and rule check
steps.body: We measure, check soil, slope, sun and access, and look for protected trees, root zones or watercourses near the work.
steps.deliverable: A note of any bylaw or permit that may apply, before design work goes further.

steps.title: Plan and written scope
steps.body: We put the layout, the plant list and the order of work on paper.
steps.deliverable: A drawn layout, a plant list and a written scope that names any permit the work may need.

steps.title: Build in phases
steps.body: We prepare the ground, build the hardscape, then plant and mulch.
steps.deliverable: An update as each phase finishes.

steps.title: Walkthrough and care notes
steps.body: We walk the finished work with you and go over anything you want changed.
steps.deliverable: Watering and care notes for the first season.

guarantee.heading: Our workmanship guarantee
body: If something we built, planted or repaired is not right, tell us. Our workmanship guarantee is: [WARRANTY].
To raise a concern, [contact us](/contact/) with the address, what you noticed and a photo if you can. We reply within [REPLY TIME] and arrange a time to look at it with you.
If you want the guarantee explained for your job, ask us before you accept the quote.
